hintReasonDiscardLow: Cannot follow suit — discard a low card
hintReasonLeadHigh: Lead a strong card to seize the initiative
hintReasonLeadLow: Lead a low card to conserve strength
promptBidHelp: bid <0-4> ... 0=Pass, 1=Six (6 tricks), 2=Misère (0 tricks, no trump), 3=Seven (7 tricks), 4=Eight (8 tricks); a non-pass must beat the current bid
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (A high; must follow the led suit)
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... score and go to the next round
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... go to the next trick
